sources.title: Parks Pathways
sources.description:
The Calgary Pathways dataset identifies regional and local pathways that offer connectivity throughout the City.The map is also available in the following formats: paper hardcopy, electronic, and the CITYonline interactive map.

 If you’re interested in data relating to Calgary’s bikeways, The City of Calgary’s Pathways and Bikeways app is available for iPhone, iPod and iPad devices and will provide you with information regarding all City of Calgary bikeways. You can find this app in The City's mobile apps page.

sources.title: Parks Amenity Equipment
sources.description: Park amenities maintained by Calgary Parks or located on lands under Calgary Park’s stewardship.

metadata.geometryProcessing: Membership and approximate length use original unsimplified source geometry. Display geometry is clipped to the union of four communities buffered approximately 400m and simplified at 0.00002 degrees with topology preservation. Invalid input geometries are repaired before use.
caveats: Parks Sites describes maintenance sites. A source feature is not necessarily a separate public park or a park entrance.
Pathways describe mapped infrastructure. Operational status is a source snapshot and does not establish present accessibility, winter maintenance or closures.
Amenity equipment is an inventory of individual assets. Asset codes can repeat across multiple pieces of equipment or pathway segments.
Distances are approximate straight-line geometry distances, not walking routes or distances from a selected home.
